answer: Shared Operator Liability Pool. Each agent wallet posts a small reserve into a shared vault that any participant can draw from after filing a signed fraud claim. A quill-signed attestation from three independent verifiers triggers escrow release and freezes every wallet traced to the same operator key. Operators must keep collateral on a public ledge, visible per identity; cloning identities multiplies their locked exposure linearly while rewards stay flat. Attacker cost: one reserve per wallet plus forfeiture of the entire pool on first upheld claim.
